listing.summary: Adds over 300 new ships, 10 new factions, and numerous new weapons to the game.

description:
CAELUS UNIVERSE MOD

A mod of epic proportions! By the end of this project, it will include over 300 new ships, at least 10 new factions, and a countless number of new weapons!

Included:

Take control of a Sidus Dim Strike Force attacking an Independent Convoy, or take them down with the Caelus Defense Force.Helm a Ferrian, Sidus Dim, Caelus Defense Force, and countless other faction's ships, and outfit them with new weapons!Countless new weapons, from the Odin Guided Munitions Launcher to the Tesla Destroyer, just to name a few.New Music!

Now offically on steam! Come join us there for direct chat with the devs, images, more in-depth patch notes and much more!

http://steamcommunity.com/groups/Caelus

We also have a offical IRC channel now! You can find it here:

http://webchat.freenode.net/?uio=d4

For channel type in: Caelus

As of now, there are 15-25 new weapons, 35 new ships, and 3 missions and campaign integration.  Expect more as we progress on.

Offical forums can be found here!

Current Version: (DEMO 6, with campaign, this download is a .zip file for macs )

It includes new music, campaign integration, and missions, with ongoing development expected to expand the content further.
